    Gradings with a homogeneous basis #

    For a graded algebra with a basis of homogeneous vectors: the coordinates of a homogeneous element vanish off its degree, and a bilinear map is homogeneous of a given degree (or character) as soon as its values on pairs of basis vectors are.
